verdict.reason: The script accurately depicts an honor guard firing a three-volley rifle salute in close proximity to mourners in Scene S005. The cited CSATF Safety Bulletin #1 excerpts directly establish both the requirement for a safety meeting with an on-site walk-through or dry run prior to firearm use and the requirement for PPE (including eye, hearing protection, or shields) for personnel in close proximity or in the line of fire. The remedy uses the standardized inquiry text.

kept.finding: Scene S005 depicts an honor guard firing a three-volley rifle salute in close proximity to attendees. If practical firearms or blanks are utilized on set, CSATF Safety Bulletin #1 specifies that production must conduct a safety meeting with all involved personnel including an on-site walk-through or dry run before any firearm is used, and that protective shields, eye and hearing protection, or other appropriate personal protective equipment shall be issued and utilized by all personnel in close proximity or directly in the line of fire.
